notes: Machine-readable catalog of the patterns in SKILL.md. 'watch' entries are phrases or constructions to grep for; 'fix' is the one-line remediation. See SKILL.md for full before/after examples.

patterns.title: Undue Emphasis on Significance, Legacy, and Broader Trends
patterns.fix: State what happened in one plain sentence.

patterns.title: Undue Emphasis on Notability and Media Coverage
patterns.fix: Cite one specific outlet, date, and quote instead of name-dropping a list.

patterns.title: Superficial Analyses with -ing Endings
patterns.fix: Cut the present-participle tail; state the fact.

patterns.title: Promotional and Advertisement-like Language
patterns.fix: Replace with neutral, concrete description.

patterns.title: Vague Attributions and Weasel Words
patterns.fix: Name the actual source with a date.

patterns.title: Outline-like Challenges and Future Prospects Sections
patterns.fix: Give specific challenges with facts, not a boilerplate section.

patterns.title: Overused AI Vocabulary Words
patterns.fix: Prefer plain synonyms; these words co-occur, so clusters matter.

patterns.title: Avoidance of is/are (Copula Avoidance)
patterns.fix: Use is/are/has.

patterns.title: Negative Parallelisms and Tailing Negations
watch: It's not just X, it's Y
patterns.fix: Write the point as an ordinary clause.

patterns.title: Rule of Three Overuse
watch: three-item lists of parallel nouns or phrases
patterns.fix: Use a natural number of items.

patterns.title: Elegant Variation (Synonym Cycling)
watch: repeated renaming of the same referent
patterns.fix: Repeat the name when it is clearest.

patterns.title: False Ranges
watch: from X to Y where X and Y are not on a shared scale
patterns.fix: List the items directly.

patterns.title: Passive Voice and Subjectless Fragments
patterns.fix: Name the actor when it helps clarity.

patterns.title: Em Dashes (and En Dashes): Cut Them
patterns.fix: Hard constraint: replace with period, comma, colon, or parentheses.

patterns.title: Overuse of Boldface
patterns.fix: Remove mechanical emphasis.

patterns.title: Inline-Header Vertical Lists
watch: **Header:** text repeating the header as a list item
patterns.fix: Convert to prose.

patterns.title: Title Case in Headings
watch: Headings with every main word capitalized
patterns.fix: Use sentence case.

patterns.title: Emojis
patterns.fix: Remove; write the words.

patterns.title: Curly Quotation Marks
patterns.fix: Use straight quotes (weak alone; counts in clusters).

patterns.title: Collaborative Communication Artifacts
patterns.fix: Remove chatbot correspondence framing.

patterns.title: Knowledge-Cutoff Disclaimers and Speculative Gap-Filling
watch: Up to my last training update
patterns.fix: Say what is not known, or cut the sentence; never dress a guess as fact.

patterns.title: Sycophantic/Servile Tone
patterns.fix: Respond directly without praise.

patterns.title: Filler Phrases
watch: It is important to note that
patterns.fix: Use the plain form (to, because, now, if, can).

patterns.title: Excessive Hedging
patterns.fix: One hedge maximum; prefer committing.

patterns.title: Generic Positive Conclusions
watch: major step in the right direction
patterns.fix: End on a specific fact or plan.

patterns.title: Hyphenated Word Pair Overuse
patterns.fix: Keep attributive-position hyphens; drop predicate-position hyphens.

patterns.title: Persuasive Authority Tropes
patterns.fix: State the point without ceremony.

patterns.title: Signposting and Announcements
watch: here's what you need to know
patterns.fix: Start with the content.

patterns.title: Fragmented Headers
watch: heading followed by a one-line paragraph that restates it
patterns.fix: Let the heading do the work.

patterns.title: Diff-Anchored Writing
watch: narrative of a change instead of current state
patterns.fix: Describe the thing as it is, not what changed.

patterns.title: Manufactured Punchlines and Staccato Drama
watch: runs of 1-4 word declarative fragments ('No X. No Y. No Z.')
patterns.fix: Vary rhythm; keep at most one short emphasis.

patterns.title: Aphorism Formulas
watch: X is the Y of Z
X is not a tool but a mirror
patterns.fix: Replace the formula with the concrete claim.

patterns.title: Conversational Rhetorical Openers
patterns.fix: Just say the thing; no theatrical pause-and-reveal.

patterns.title: Uniform Sentence Cadence (Low Burstiness)
watch: most sentences 15-25 words, even rhythm, no short/long variation
patterns.fix: Vary sentence length deliberately.

patterns.title: Eerie Uniformity (Absence of Imperfection)
watch: no contractions, no dropped 'that', uniformly perfect punctuation, no colloquial release
patterns.fix: Let natural imperfections in; do not add errors.

patterns.title: Treadmill Effect (Low Information Density)
watch: same idea restated in fresh words; length without new information
patterns.fix: Cut restatement; raise information per word.

patterns.title: Latinate Bias (High-Register Word Choice)
patterns.fix: Prefer short everyday verbs (use, start, show, get, more, then, about).

patterns.title: Positivity Bias and Motivational Framing
patterns.fix: Write neutrally and concretely; cheerleading on cue is a tell.

patterns.title: Suspiciously Balanced Perspectives
watch: While some argue X, others contend Y
On one hand... on the other hand
patterns.fix: Make a judgment call where the evidence supports one side.

patterns.title: Hedge Openers and Topic-Setting Formulas
patterns.fix: Cut to the subject.

patterns.title: Editorializing Asides
patterns.fix: State the fact; drop the aside.

patterns.title: Formulaic Contrast Micro-Templates
watch: Not because X. But because Y.
It's not about X, it's about Y
No X. No Y. Just Z.
patterns.fix: Write a plain claim in a plain sentence.

patterns.title: Model-Specific Artifact Strings
patterns.fix: Strip artifacts; verify every cited source.

patterns.title: Markdown Leaking into Non-Markdown Text
patterns.fix: Render as plain prose.

patterns.title: Structural Quirks
watch: 'List of X' is a curated... lead
patterns.fix: Fix heading levels; remove decorative rules; name the actual subject.

patterns.title: Fabricated or Unverifiable Citations
watch: journal-volume-page combos that do not exist
patterns.fix: Verify every citation; replace or remove anything unverifiable.

patterns.title: Edit-Summary and Reviewer-Addressing Phrasing
watch: made sure to include sourced content
patterns.fix: Describe the content, not the edit that produced it.
